item.title: Florists Invent New Money Bouquets After CBK Warning
item.description: The CBK recently warned Kenyans against disfiguring cash through money bouquets, cautioning that the practice contravenes the law.

item.title: Family of Slain Kenyan Soldier in Russia Buries an Empty Coffin
item.description: The government is under pressure to end the luring of Kenyans to fight in the war that has claimed thousands on the battlefield.

item.title: Man Beaten and Set on Fire in Kabete After Women Yells for Help
item.description: Two women, accused of robbing the man, yelled for help after a scuffle between them, and within minutes the man was on fire.

item.title: Relief for Kenyans in Latest Trump Orders
item.description: Trump has pulled out of several major bodies and withheld funding relied upon by thousands of Kenyans suffering from the deadly HIV and AIDS.

item.title: Tension as Armed Police Lob Tear Gas at Students in Night Protests
item.description: Videos and images shared on the internet showed smoke billowing from one of the campus facilities as the learners protested inside the institution.

item.title: Gas Depot Explodes in Nairobi Estate
item.description: Residents have been captured scampering for safety as emergency teams respond to the incident that has caused panic in the area.

item.title: ODM Hits Back at Uhuru After Azimio Leadership Changes
item.description: ODM hit out at Uhuru after he presided over a meeting that saw the appointment of Kalonzo as the Azimio leader and Caroli Omondi as the Secretary General.

item.title: High Court Orders IG Kanja, DCI Amin to Produce Abducted Trader
item.description: The abduction of Ibrahim Mohamed adds to the growing list of enforced disappearances by state operators, with them ever denying responsibility.

item.title: NPS Addresses Transfer of Senior Police Officers to Nairobi
item.description: Senator Cherargei had raised concerns over the transfers that followed public statements calling for disciplinary actions against the officers.

item.title: Govt Announces Reopening of Kenya-Somalia Border
item.description: The reopening of the border is considered important for regional stability and the strengthening of diplomatic ties that were strained for over a decade.
